data_fields.name: minimap rebuild trigger
data_fields.donor_constant: map flag at the GUI tick, and each new month (flag, not a timer)

best_idea: Keep a cached zone map that is rebuilt only when a map-change flag is set, then centre a small window on the player and clamp it to the zone bounds on both axes.
decision_why: A zone minimap built from zone data with a change-flag rebuild is cheap and fits our HUD; the flag must come from server-confirmed ledger events, and the donor's x clamp bug is fixed in the sketch; the full-map rebuild must become a dirty-region draw.
acceptance: At 375 px in an open zone, the minimap shows the zone centred on the player and stops at the zone edges; a test on a non-square minimap asserts the window anchor stays within the bounds on both axes; a kill or spawn event marks the minimap dirty and the marker updates on the next GUI tick; tapping a minimap tile moves the world view to that tile.
